deadline.value: MASc and PhD applications for September 2027 open August 4, 2026 and close February 2, 2027 (domestic and international).
deadline.quote: MASc & PhD | Domestic & International | August 4, 2026 | February 2, 2027

gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission to our programs.

gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are not required for admission to our programs.

supervisor.value: You don't have to secure a supervisor yourself; the department identifies one for you before admission. Contacting professors matters mainly for January/May starts.
supervisor.quote: Is a supervisor identified before or after admission? MASc, PhD: Before | Is a supervisor assigned by the graduate unit or secured by the applicant? MASc, PhD: Grad Unit

funding.value: Full-time PhD students get a guaranteed funding package for a set period.
funding.quote: Full-time MASc & PhD students are guaranteed a funding package for a set period of registration.

entry_route.value: PhD normally needs a master's (B+); direct entry from a bachelor's needs an A- across the whole degree.
entry_route.quote: Direct-Entry PhD: Completion of an undergraduate degree. GPA across the entire bachelor's degree must be equivalent to an A- (3.7/4.0 or 80%).

english_waiver.value: CivMin's rules are stricter than SGS: only degrees from Canada and a listed set of countries are exempt, and India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need an English test.
english_waiver.quote: The ELP requirements for admission to our programs differs from those outlined on the School of Graduate Studies website. For our graduate programs, you must provide an official score from a test recognized by the School of Graduate Studies, unless any of the following exemptions apply to you

notes: Fee CAD 135 paid by the deadline. MASc/PhD can also start in January or May with a professor's support.
